title: AI Response Tone and Professionalism Enforcement
description: Detects emoji characters, forbidden enthusiasm phrases, and unprofessional tone markers in AI-generated output, comments, and string literals. Enforces AGENTS.md Rule 3.J and master-rules.md R5.

rules.message: Emoji character detected in source. AGENTS.md Rule 3.J: Zero Emoji policy. No emoji under any circumstance.
rules.remediation: Remove the emoji. Use [CRITICAL], [SUCCESS], [INFO], [WARN], [ERROR] text tags for emphasis.

rules.message: Forbidden enthusiasm phrase detected. AGENTS.md Rule 3.J: Strictly professional tone required.
rules.remediation: Replace with data-driven, mechanical description. Remove emotional qualifiers entirely.

rules.message: Forbidden enthusiasm phrase detected in English. Strictly professional tone required.
Forbidden praise detected in code comment. Comments must be technical, not evaluative.
rules.remediation: Rewrite the comment as a technical description of what the code does.
